body: a91a8c1 BoneTrackGraft.graft() — one static module, two callers (probe_anim.gd, fight_world_anim_test.gd). bone_track_graft_test 17/0, fight_world_anim_test 23/0. A track that names a bone the fighter does not have goes into unmatched (PackedStringArray), never silently dropped. An already-grafted track (Skeleton3D:Chest) splits to bone name Skeleton3D which does not match, so the track is left unchanged — no Skeleton3D:Skeleton3D:Chest double prefix.
